attacked.rule_yaml:
title: PowerShell Encoded Command with Evasion Flags
id: ec16890b-1d20-51fc-8ad7-0ce6372ff4d8
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell execution with an encoded command (-enc/-encodedcommand)
  combined with evasion flags such as -nop, -noP, -w hidden, -sta, or -noninteractive.
  This pattern is characteristic of Empire, Metasploit, and other offensive frameworks
  that use encoded payloads with AMSI bypass and stager logic.
author: Sentinel Loop rule_gen v0
date: '2026-10-22'
tags:
- attack.t1059.001
- attack.t1027
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection1_1:
    Image|endswith:
    - powershell.exe
    - pwsh.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
    - -enc
    - -encodedcommand
  selection1_2:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - -nop
    - -noprofile
    - -noP
    - -w hidden
    - -w 1
    - -windowstyle hidden
    - -sta
    - -noninteractive
  condition: all of selection1_*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative scripts using encoded commands with evasion flags
- Approved red team exercises or penetration tests
level: high
attacked.feedback:
TP: fires on 6/6 held-out T1059.001/empire-encoded-stager (procedure) attacks in process_creation
benign: fires on 0/60 benign_noisy events in process_creation
siblings (info, not graded): fires on 1/11 attacks of another procedure or sub-technique
noise: 0/238 held-out pool events in process_creation fire
